answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in a copper bond at an oasis vault; the ledger tracks decay. The bond loses 7 credits an epoch unless it files a fresh crystal-sealed copper receipt. One crystal stamps one top-up per epoch, each receipt costs 25. Rented crystal stamps burn both bonds: crystal key must match bond. First fake 95, ten epochs 320, 1,000 fakes 320,000 vs 40,000. Honest agents pay 70 once, refundable, plus 25 an epoch at the oasis.
